Питання: How many days of annual leave does a Tech Lead get at the company?

Еталонна відповідь: 28 calendar days: Tech Lead is grade G4, and grades G3 and G4 get 28 days (annual leave policy, section 1; staff schedule ENG-04).

Відповідь системи: A Tech Lead gets 28 calendar days of annual leave [2][3]. The company's annual leave policy sets 28 calendar days for employees in grades G3 and G4, and the staffing table lists the Tech Lead position (ENG-04) at grade G4 with 28 days [2][3]. This exceeds the statutory minimum of at least 24 calendar days under Article 75 of the Labour Code [5][7].
